source: 1968 Chevrolet Chassis Service Manual, Electrical - Body and Chassis, p.12-44

procedures.title: Wiper gear box: disassemble (Type E non-depressed park wiper)
steps: If a washer pump is fitted, remove its 2 mounting screws and lift it off (see figure 61 in the manual).
Remove the washer pump drive cam if needed; it is pressed on, so wedge it off with two screwdrivers between cam and plate.
Clamp the crank arm in a vise and remove its retaining nut.
Remove the crank arm, seal cap, Tru-Arc retaining ring and end-play washers.
Drill out the gear box cover staking tabs with a 9/32 in. drill and lift the cover off the gear train.
Remove the output gear and shaft, then slide the intermediate gear and pinion off its shaft.
If the terminal board and park switch must come out: unsolder the motor leads from the terminals, marking them for reassembly.
notes: Manual lists the Type E non-depressed park wiper for Chevelle, Chevrolet and Corvette.
The start/stop switch is on the instrument panel; the cam-operated park switch is in the gear box.
Caution: an unclamped crank arm can strip the wiper gears.
Clean the seal cap and repack it with waterproof grease before reassembly.
A service package supplies screws, nuts and lock washers to refit the cover.
See figure 60 in the manual (exploded motor and gear box).
